title: A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains
start: Talk to Martin the Master Gardener in Draynor Village.

items.t: Secateurs (tool belt will not work, can be obtained during the quest from Vanessa near Dantaera)
Three or four random items assigned individually for each player

recommended.t: Activated Ardougne, Catherby, Canifis, Draynor, Falador, Varrock and Yanille lodestone
Druid pouches (to avoid getting hurt by the ghasts in the Mort Myre Swamp)
Skills necklace (faster teleport to Dark Wizards' Tower and Malignius Mortifer)

rewards.t: Wielding the magic secateurs, having them in the backpack or in the tool belt while harvesting allotments, herbs, hops and nightshades, increases the chance of saving a harvest life by 10%.

steps.t: Talk to Martin the Master Gardener in Draynor Village. [Chat: 2 General Chat › 1 Anything I can help with? › Accept › 1 Now that I think about it, you're right!]
Talk to 5 different gardeners near farming patches around RuneScape. Easy options include:

sub.t: Frizzy, on the other side of the wall, just west of Martin. [Chat: 2 Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?]
Elstan, to the north of Frizzy. [Chat: 2 Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?]
If Garden of Tranquillity has been started. [Chat: 1 Fairy Tale Part I - Growing Pains]
Alain, north of Taverley lodestone. [Chat: 2 Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?]
Dantaera, north-west of Catherby lodestone. [Chat: 2 Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?]
If Garden of Tranquillity has been started. [Chat: 1 Fairy Tale Part I - Growing Pains]
If you do not have secateurs yet, buy them from Vanessa's Farming Shop just to the south.
Ellena, east of the Catherby lodestone, beside the fruit tree patch on the beach. [Chat: 2 Are you a member of the Group of Advanced Gardeners?]

p: Talking to Martin the Master Gardener in Draynor Village.

steps.t: Note that:

sub.t: Spirit Tree Patch gardeners all count as the same gardener.
The gardeners in Prifddinas won't work.
The zombie farmer does not work.
Head Farmer Jones in Taverley won't work.
Wyson the gardener in Falador won't work.
Demetrius in Wendlewick won't work.

steps.t: The fifth gardener you talk to will mention fairies.
Talk to Martin again. [Chat: 2 Talk about farming problems.]
Equip your dramen staff or lunar staff and head to the Lumbridge Swamp to enter the Lost City shed.
Run south and talk to the Fairy Godfather (near Chaeldar, the Slayer master) about the Queen. [Chat: 2 Where's the Fairy Queen?] Make sure to finish the whole dialogue.
Run west to the bank, then go north a few steps and talk to Fairy Nuff.
Travel to the Dark Wizards' Tower, west of Falador (use the skills necklace teleport to Crafting Guild or teleport to Port Sarim lodestone, and then run north-west).
Climb to the top, talk to Zandar Horfyre.

sub.t: Player with low combat level should be aware of the aggressive dark wizards inside the tower.

steps.t: Teleport to Port Sarim and talk to Malignius Mortifer (just north-west of Port Sarim, pictured right) about a Tanglefoot. [Chat: 2 I need help with fighting a Tanglefoot.] or [Chat: 1 I need help with fighting a Tanglefoot.] if Swan Song has been completed.

sub.t: Talking to Malignius at the Um ritual site will not work.

steps.t: Head back to Draynor Village and enter the gates of Draynor Manor.
Dig the gravestone inside the fence, north of the manor, west of the gallows. It resembles a celtic cross.
p: Place: Gravestone (A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains)

steps.t: Return to Malignius. [Chat: 2 I was asking you about fighting a Tanglefoot...] or [Chat: 1 I was asking you about fighting a Tanglefoot...] if Swan Song has been started.
Fetch the items that Malignius requested (they will be listed in your quest journal), then make your way to the Nature Spirit.

sub.t: Make sure to bring extra of any requested food items or bring a filled druid pouch to ward off ghasts.
Make sure to clean any requested herbs.

p: The nature spirit enchants the secateurs using the spell Phasma Phasmatis Natura.

steps.t: Talk to the Nature Spirit in Mort Myre Swamp to receive magic secateurs.
Return to Zanaris, then enter the shady grove (dungeon icon) west of the cosmic altar.

sub.t: You can use a cosmic altar teleport to teleport to the cosmic altar.

steps.t: Run south around the bend then north to the opening with the Tanglefoot.
Equip your magic secateurs and kill Tanglefoot.

sub.t: Off-hand weaponry will work here, but will only deal as much as the secateurs would.

steps.t: Take the Queen's secateurs (area loot will not work).
Talk to the Fairy Godfather, Next to the Slayer Master icon.
Quest complete!
